def group_mean_group_std_advantages(advantage_groups, rewards, eps=1e-4):
    """Center and scale rewards within each advantage group."""
    advantage_groups = np.asarray(advantage_groups)
    rewards = np.asarray(rewards, dtype=np.float64)
    advantages = np.zeros_like(rewards, dtype=np.float64)
    for group in np.unique(advantage_groups):
        group_mask = advantage_groups == group
        group_rewards = rewards[group_mask]
        group_mean = np.mean(group_rewards, axis=0, keepdims=True)
        group_std = np.std(group_rewards, axis=0, keepdims=True) + eps
        advantages[group_mask] = (group_rewards - group_mean) / group_std
    return advantages
